description: Synchronous atomic bulk source-file upload. Adds POST /api/v1/studies/{study_id}/source-files:bulk (multipart, many file parts) that creates one immutable checksum-addressed SourceFile per file in request order, all-or-nothing. Self-contained in the artifacts module; independent of FEAT-002, but ordered first because the async dataset import (FEAT-002) references already-uploaded source_file_ids and its tests upload files this way. Design: §4.1, §5.1, AC1, AC9 Finding 7, Finding 5(round2). Reuses the existing create_source_file checks exactly.
steps: Add the setting raw_bulk_upload_max_files: int = 50 to Settings in src/app/config.py, placed near source_file_max_bytes / source_file_allowed_media_types (settings layer only; no env reads elsewhere).

Add ArtifactService.create_source_files_bulk(self, session, storage, settings, study_id, uploads: list[UploadFile], principal) -> list[SourceFile] to src/app/artifacts/service.py. Two-pass flow: (1) require_access; validate part count 1..settings.raw_bulk_upload_max_files (empty -> ProblemException 422 raw_bulk_upload_empty; too many -> 413 raw_bulk_upload_too_many); for EVERY part validate the display filename via _safe_display_filename and media type against the source_file_allowed_media_types allow-list BEFORE streaming any bytes (reuse the exact 415 unsupported_media_type / 422 invalid_filename|filename_required paths). (2) Upload pass: for each part strictly one at a time, stream to its own tempfile.NamedTemporaryFile enforcing settings.source_file_max_bytes (413 source_file_too_large), compute SHA-256, object_key = checksum_object_key(sha256), storage.put_file, and unlink the temp file in a finally BEFORE the next part is streamed (at most one temp file at a time); build (do not commit) the Artifact + SourceFile metadata rows in memory exactly as create_source_file does (same module_key='raw', artifact_type='source_file', owner_type='source_file', generator_name/version, manifest). (3) session.commit() once for all staged rows; return the SourceFile rows in request order. Note UploadFile.read is async, so this method is async def and must await part reads and close each part.
Add SourceFileBulkResponse(BaseModel) to src/app/artifacts/schemas.py with items: tuple[SourceFileResponse, ...].

Add the route POST /studies/{study_id}/source-files:bulk to src/app/artifacts/routes.py next to create_source_file: async handler taking files: list[UploadFile], status_code=201, returning SourceFileBulkResponse(items=...). Read settings from request.app.state.settings like create_source_file does. Do not set object keys/paths in the response.

Add unit tests (tests/unit) for create_source_files_bulk using a fake/in-memory storage and a fake session: happy path returns one SourceFile per part in order; a disallowed media type or unsafe filename in the metadata pass rejects the whole batch and commits NO rows; an empty list -> 422 raw_bulk_upload_empty; too many parts -> 413 raw_bulk_upload_too_many.

Add a contract test (tests/contract) asserting the :bulk operation appears in the OpenAPI document and returns 201 with an items array of SourceFileResponse-shaped objects (snake_case). If PHASE1_OPERATIONS in tests/contract/typed_client_fixture.py is the right home for /api/v1/studies/{study_id}/source-files, add the :bulk path there and keep tests/contract/test_modules.py green.

Add a storage-integration test (tests/integration, gated by AURINARA_INTEGRATION=1, reusing MemoryStorage/TestTokenVerifier and make_test_settings): a :bulk upload of several files produces distinct SourceFile rows with correct checksums; a mid-batch oversize file rejects the whole request and commits no rows; a temp-dir spy asserts no two temp files coexist during the upload pass.
acceptance_criteria: POST /api/v1/studies/{study_id}/source-files:bulk accepts a multipart request with many file parts and returns 201 with one SourceFileResponse per file in request order.
A single rejected file (bad size, media type, or filename) fails the whole request with application/problem+json and commits zero source_files/artifacts rows.
Running `ruff check . && ruff format --check . && mypy src workers` succeeds.
Running `pytest tests/unit tests/contract` passes, including the new bulk-upload tests.
With Compose Postgres+MinIO up and AURINARA_INTEGRATION=1, `pytest tests/integration` passes the new storage-integration test.
verification: cd into the worktree; ruff check . ; ruff format --check . ; mypy src workers
findings: IMPLEMENTED & VERIFIED (ruff check/format, mypy src workers, pytest tests/unit tests/contract = 219 passed, AURINARA_INTEGRATION=1 pytest tests/integration = 23 passed/5 runner-skipped). Contract surface for FEAT-002: (1) Final endpoint path = POST /api/v1/studies/{study_id}/source-files:bulk (multipart; form field name is 'files', a list of UploadFile); returns 201 with body SourceFileBulkResponse = {"items": [SourceFileResponse, ...]} in request order (one immutable checksum-addressed SourceFile per part, all-or-nothing single commit). SourceFileResponse fields are unchanged snake_case: id, study_id, artifact_id, filename, media_type, sha256, size, created_by, created_at (no object_key leaked). (2) New setting name = raw_bulk_upload_max_files (int, default 50) in app.config.Settings, placed right after source_file_allowed_media_types. (3) New service method = ArtifactService.create_source_files_bulk(session, storage, settings, study_id, uploads: list[UploadFile], principal) -> list[SourceFile] in src/app/artifacts/service.py; async; two-pass (validate all filenames/media types -> stream one-at-a-time with single live temp file -> one session.commit()). Error codes raised: 422 raw_bulk_upload_empty, 413 raw_bulk_upload_too_many, plus reused 415 unsupported_media_type / 422 invalid_filename|filename_required / 413 source_file_too_large. (4) Refactor FEAT-002 can reuse: new module-level helpers in artifacts/service.py = _validate_upload_metadata(upload, allowed_media_types) -> (filename, media_type), _stream_upload(upload, storage, settings, media_type) -> StoredObject, _build_source_file_rows(*, study_id, filename, media_type, stored, created_by) -> (Artifact, SourceFile); create_source_file now composes these too. (5) New schema SourceFileBulkResponse in src/app/artifacts/schemas.py. (6) Contract fixture: added path '/api/v1/studies/{study_id}/source-files:bulk': {'post'} to PHASE1_OPERATIONS in tests/contract/typed_client_fixture.py (test_modules.test_versioned_openapi_contains_foundation_routes + new tests/contract/test_bulk_source_files.py cover it). (7) Test helpers for FEAT-002 to reuse: tests/integration MemoryStorage & TestTokenVerifier imported from tests.integration.test_phase1_core; make_test_settings from tests.conftest; new tests/integration/test_phase1_bulk_upload.py adds TempSpyStorage(MemoryStorage) with begin_spy()/observed_concurrent to assert single-live-temp-file behavior. Unit tests in tests/unit/test_artifacts_bulk_upload.py use FakeUpload/FakeStorage/FakeSession and monkeypatch service._studies.require_access.
